title: warden deploy-result artifact
description: Provenance for one deploy attempt: which commit, under which rules_version, whether the gate's preconditions held (reachable from the deploy branch + a clean committed attestation), and what the declared scope commands did. A refused deploy still writes this artifact — the refusal IS the evidence.

commit.description: the fully resolved commit the deploy was asked to ship; a deploy proceeds only when `head` equals it

head.description: the checkout's HEAD when the check ran — deploy runs the working tree, so head != commit is a named refusal

dirty.description: whether the working tree carried uncommitted content BEFORE any scope command ran (a dirty tree is a named refusal; an unreportable tree state aborts the run at exit 2, so this field is never a guess). Distinct from run.dirty, which is measured before the first command and after the last, and may reflect files they wrote

branch.description: the branch a deployable commit must be reachable from, as given to --branch

branch_tip.description: the commit `branch` resolved to when the check ran

scope.description: the repo.yaml deploy: scope this run was asked to execute

rules_version.description: the ruleset digest in force when the deploy ran — binds the artifact to the policy, not just the code

reachable_from_branch.description: whether `commit` is an ancestor of `branch_tip`; false is a named refusal, never a warning

clean_attestation.description: the clean-verdict shard the commit's own first-parent diff introduced, read from the commit's tree (never the filesystem) — the binding that survives a squash merge, where no shard sha does. null exactly when the store was readable and no clean shard was introduced; an unreadable store aborts the run (exit 2) and writes no artifact, so null is never 'could not tell'.

refusals.description: every reason this deploy was refused, each naming its cause; empty when the preconditions held

deployed.description: true only when the preconditions held AND every declared command in the scope exited 0

run.description: the verify-result document for the scope run (already validated against verify-result.schema.json by the shared runner); null when the deploy was refused before any command ran
